source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    for color in colors - {bg}:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if r1-r0 >= 2 and c1-c0 >= 2:
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1 == 7 and c1-c0+1 == 7) or (r1-r0+1 == 3 and c1-c0+1 == 3) else 2

                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if grid[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
